content: Hi how can i assist you today
My robot vacuum approaches me when I think ‘come here,’ even if I don’t touch the app.
Vacuum paths follow mapped zones and obstacle detection. Does it approach at the same point in its cleaning route?
Often near the couch after it cleans the kitchen.
That suggests a routine path. If you move an obstacle in its route, does the approach shift to a different spot?
When the coffee table is moved, it pauses elsewhere.
Pauses usually reflect sensor checks. The ‘come here’ feeling may coincide with that scheduled pause.
The timing matches the map’s path order.
Path order plus sensor behavior can recreate the same moment each run.
That accounts for why it feels responsive.
